advanced-filter-description: Sefa yapamwamba imalola kulemba mawu okhala ndi zizindikiro izi: == != <= >= && || ( ) Danga limagwiritsidwa ntchito kulekanitsa zizindikirozo. Mungasefe malo onse apadera polemba mayina ndi mitengo yake. Mwachitsanzo: Field1 == Value1. Dziwani: Ngati malo kapena mitengo ili ndi mipata, muyenera kuizungulira ndi zizindikiro za mawu amodzi. Mwachitsanzo: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Kuti zilembo zapadera chimodzi (' \/) zilumphidwe, mungagwiritse ntchito \. Mwachitsanzo: Field1 == I\'m. Mungaphatikizenso zinthu zingapo. Mwachitsanzo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Nthawi zambiri zizindikiro zonse zimatanthauziridwa kuchokera kumanzere kupita kumanja. Mungasinthe dongosolo poika mabulaketi. Mwachitsanzo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Mungafufuzenso m'malo a mawu pogwiritsa ntchito regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Fufuzani m'malo ogwirira ntchito. Dinani Enter kupita ku chofanana chotsatira, Shift+Enter ku chofanana chapitalo. Dinani Escape kutseka kufufuza ndi kuyang'ana chofanana chapano.

card-archive-suggest-cancel: Mutha kubwezeretsa khadi kuchokera ku Zosungidwa pambuyo pake.

click-to-star: Dinani kuti muyike nyenyezi pa bolodi ili.
click-to-unstar: Dinani kuti muchotse nyenyezi pa bolodi ili.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ndi ya SuperAdmin yekha, pa Domeni ya Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Ndi WeKan mu Weddy, Cloud Panel imatumikira madomeni ambiri a WeKan kuchokera pa seva imodzi, iliyonse ndi deta yake. Pa Domeni ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin amayang'anira madomeni ndi CloudFlare.
cloud-superadmin-username: Dzina la wogwiritsa ntchito la SuperAdmin
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ndi kiyi ya CloudFlare API, domeni yomwe zone yake ili mu akaunti yanu ya CloudFlare imalandira rekodi ya DNS yodutsa pa proxy ndi satifiketi ya CloudFlare Origin. Madomeni ena amalandira satifiketi ya Let's Encrypt. Kiyi imasungidwa pa seva ndipo siidzawonetsedwanso.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Palibe kiyi ya CloudFlare API yosungidwa: domeni iliyonse imalandira satifiketi ya Let's Encrypt.

csv-mapping-list-missing: Fayilo ilibe mzati wa mndandanda. Sankhani umodzi pamwambapa, kapena lembani dzina la mndandanda umodzi womwe khadi lililonse limalowamo.
csv-mapping-list-required: Lembani dzina la mndandanda womwe khadi lililonse limalowamo, kapena sankhani mzati womwe uli ndi mndandanda.
csv-mapping-title-required: Sankhani mzati womwe uli ndi mitu ya makhadi.

email-recovery-busy: Kutumiza kapena ntchito ina ya pamzere ikuchitika. Sinthani zimene zikuonetsedwa ndipo yesaninso pakapita nthawi yochepa.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Muletse mauthenga onse omwe ali pamzere panopa a wolandira uyu? Zomwe zili m'mauthengawo zichotsedwa ndipo sizingabwezeretsedwe. Mauthenga atsopano omwe apangidwa pambuyo pa pempholi adzasungidwa.
email-recovery-description: Mzere umodzi pa wolandira aliyense. Sakani ndi ID ya wogwiritsa ntchito. Zomwe zili mu uthenga ndi malo a imelo ya wolandira sizionetsedwa. Kuimitsa kaye kumasunga mauthenga omwe alipo ndi omwe adzabwere; Kupitiriza kumayesanso kutumiza mauthenga omwe ali pamzere panopa. Kuletsa kumachotsa mauthenga omwe anaikidwa pamzere mpaka nthawi ya pempho. Ngati kutumiza kuli pa ntchito, yesaninso pakapita nthawi yochepa. Uthenga womwe wayamba kale kutumizidwa sungabwezedwe, ndipo kutumiza komwe zotsatira zake sizikudziwika kungabwerezedwe. Zolephera zokhalitsa ndi mauthenga omwe afika pa malire oyesanso zimakhalabe kuti ziwunikidwe. Kuyesanso mauthenga omwe analephera kumayamba gawo latsopano la kuyesa ndipo kumasunga kuimitsidwa kaye komwe kulipo.
email-recovery-empty: Palibe mauthenga pamzere ndipo palibe olandira omwe kutumiza kwaimitsidwa kaye.
email-recovery-failed: Ntchitoyo sinatsimikizidwe. Sinthani zimene zikuonetsedwa pamzere ndipo yesaninso ntchito yomweyo ngati kuli kofunikira.
email-recovery-superseded: Ntchito yatsopano ya woyendetsa ntchito yalowa m'malo mwa pempholi. Mkhalidwe wa mzere wa panopa ukuonetsedwa.
email-recovery-unavailable: Sitingawerenge mzere wa maimelo. Onani zilolezo za woyang'anira ndi ngati seva ikupezeka.

error-json-schema: Deta yanu ya JSON ilibe zambiri zoyenera mu kalembedwe kolondola
error-user-notSameOrgOrTeam: Mungangowonjezera ogwiritsa ntchito ochokera m'Bungwe kapena Gulu lomwelo
error-username-taken: Dzina la wogwiritsa ntchito limeneli latengedwa kale
export-card-details: Tsatanetsatane wa khadi (khadi lililonse monga potumiza khadi)
export-card-field-board-info: Zambiri za bolodi (Bolodi, Mndandanda, Mzere wosambira)
filter-on-desc: Mukusefa makhadi pa bolodi ili. Dinani apa kuti musinthe sefa.
import-attachment-auth-hint: Zotumizidwa kunja zimatchula mayina a zolumikizidwa koma sizinyamula mafayilo. Kuti muwabweretse, perekani adilesi ya ntchitoyo ndi kulowa: zimagwiritsidwa ntchito pa kulowetsa kumeneku kokha, zimatumizidwa ku adilesi imeneyo yokha, ndipo sizisungidwa konse. Siyani chopanda kanthu kuti mulowetse popanda mafayilo.
import-attachment-auth-token: Chizindikiro cha API, kiyi ya API kapena mawu achinsinsi a pulogalamu
import-board-instruction-asana: Matani JSON yotumizidwa ya ntchito za Asana ({ "data": [...] } kuchokera potumiza kwa Asana kapena GET /tasks). Ntchito zimagawidwa m'magawo (memberships); ntchito zomalizidwa zimapita ku Done.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Mu Businessmap (yomwe kale inali Kanbanize), tsegulani Advanced Search, sankhani Configure results kuti musankhe mizati, tsitsani fayilo ya Excel, kenako sankhani fayilo ya .xlsx imeneyo. Mizati imawerengedwa ndi mayina awo a Chingerezi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): ngati akaunti yanu imagwiritsa ntchito chilankhulo china, sinthani kaye mzere wa mitu kukhala Chingerezi. Column imakhala mindandanda ndipo Lane mizere yosambira; eni ake, ma tag, mtundu, masiku, ndemanga ndi maulalo a kholo zimasunga malo awo, ndipo Priority, Size, Type ndi mizati ina imakhala malo apadera.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Mu ClickUp, tulutsani ntchito ngati CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, kapena kutulutsa kwa List kapena Table view ndi mizati yonse), kenako matani CSV. Mikhalidwe imakhala mindandanda, mindandanda ya ClickUp imakhala mizere yosambira, ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi pamodzi ndi tintchito, owaperekera ntchito, ma tag, masiku, zofunika kwambiri ndi nthawi.
import-board-instruction-csv: Matani apa mitengo yolekanitsidwa ndi koma (CSV) / mitengo yolekanitsidwa ndi tabu (TSV).
import-board-instruction-deck: Matani JSON ya bolodi la NextCloud Deck (bolodi lokhala ndi "stacks", ndipo stack iliyonse ili ndi "cards" zake). Stacks zimakhala mindandanda ndipo makhadi amakhalabe makhadi.
import-board-instruction-excel: Sankhani spreadsheet ya .xlsx ya kalembedwe ka WeKan (mizati yofanana ndi potumiza ku Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Mzere woyamba ndi mutu.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Tsegulani fayilo ya .boardarchive kuchokera m’phukusi lopanikizidwa ndipo matani zomwe zili mu board.jsonl ya bolodi, ndi mzere wa mtundu kapena popanda iwo. Chinthu chogawa m’magulu pa mawonekedwe a bolodi chimakhala mindandanda, zinthu zina zosankha zimakhala zilembo, magawo a mawu ndi mabokosi ochonga amakhala kufotokoza ndi mndandanda woyang’anira, ndipo ndemanga zimasungidwa. Zithunzi ndi mafayilo olumikizidwa sizilowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-issues: Matani mndandanda wa JSON wa ma issue a __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Ma issue amakhala makhadi ogawidwa m'mindandanda ya Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Matani JSON yotumizidwa kuchokera ku Kanboard: chinthu chokhala ndi "columns" (kapena ntchito zokhala ndi column_name) ndi mndandanda wa "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Mizati imakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Mu Kanri, tsegulani Import & Export ndipo sankhani Export individual board (kapena Export all data), kenako matani fayilo ya .json. Mizati imakhala mindandanda ndipo makhadi amakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi kufotokoza, tsiku lomaliza, ma tag ndi mitundu yawo; ntchito za khadi zimakhala mndandanda wowunika. Kuchokera ku kutulutsa kwa deta yonse, bolodi loyamba limalowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-leo: Matani dongosolo la Leo (fayilo ya .leo). Mfundo zapamwamba zimakhala mindandanda, mfundo zake zazing'ono zimakhala makadi ndipo mawu a mfundoyo amakhala kufotokoza kwa khadi. Mfundo zakuya kwambiri zimakhala mindandanda yowunikira. Mfundo zolembedwa chizindikiro zimatumizidwa mkati ngati zomalizidwa.
import-board-instruction-linear: Mu Linear, tulutsani nkhani ngati CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, kapena kutulutsa kwa view), kenako matani CSV. Mikhalidwe imakhala mindandanda, magulu amakhala mizere yosambira, ndipo nkhani zimakhala makhadi pamodzi ndi woperekedwa ntchito, zilembo, masiku, nkhani ya kholo, zofunika kwambiri, kuyerekeza, pulojekiti ndi nthawi yozungulira.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Kumbirani mndandanda wa ntchito wa markdown (msinkhu umene zida za markdown-kanban monga Obsidian Kanban zimagwiritsa ntchito): mitu ya "## Dzina la mndandanda", ndi zinthu za "- [ ]"/"- [x]" pansi pake. Mitu imasanduka mindandanda ndipo zinthu zimasanduka makhadi.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Mu MeisterTask, dinani dzina la pulojekiti, sankhani Export project ndipo tulutsani CSV, kenako imateni. Zigawo zimakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi zolemba zawo, tsiku lomaliza, woperekedwa ntchito ndi ma tag; ntchito zomalizidwa zimasunga tsiku lomwe zinamalizidwa. CSV yolembedwera kulowetsa kwa MeisterTask komweko imagwiranso ntchito.
import-board-instruction-monday: Mu monday.com, tsegulani menyu ya bolodi, sankhani More actions ndi Export board to Excel (ndi zosintha ndi tinthu tating'ono ngati mukufuna), kenako sankhani fayilo ya .xlsx imeneyo. Mzati wa Status umakhala mindandanda ndipo magulu amakhala mizere yosambira; anthu, masiku, ndondomeko ya nthawi ndi ma tag zimasunga malo awo, mizati ina imakhala malo apadera ndipo zosintha zimakhala ndemanga.
import-board-instruction-notion: Mu Notion, tsegulani database ngati tsamba lathunthu, sankhani ••• ndi Export, sankhani Markdown & CSV, ndipo sankhani fayilo ya .zip yomwe imatsitsa, kapena CSV imodzi ya database kuchokera mmenemo, kapena matani CSV imeneyo. Mzati wotchedwa Status umakhala mindandanda (popanda iwo, mzati woyamba wooneka ngati wosankha umatero, ndipo lipoti la kulowetsa limanena kuti ndi uti); mizere imakhala makhadi pamodzi ndi mutu, ma tag ngati zilembo, anthu ngati mamembala, masiku, ndi mawu a tsamba ngati kufotokoza; mizati ina imakhala malo apadera. Ubale, zithunzi ndi zolumikizidwa sizilowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Mu Nullboard, tsegulani bolodi, sankhani Export this board... pa menyu, tsegulani fayilo ya .nbx mu text editor ndipo matani zomwe zili mmenemo. Mindandanda imakhala mindandanda ndipo zolemba zimakhala makhadi: mzere woyamba wa cholemba ndi mutu wa khadi ndipo zotsalazo ndi kufotokoza kwake. Cholemba chosakonzedwa chimapatsidwa chizindikiro raw. Fayilo yokhala ndi mabolodi angapo imalowetsa bolodi lake loyamba.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Mu Obsidian, tsegulani fayilo ya bolodi la Kanban ngati Markdown (kapena tsegulani fayilo ya .md mu text editor), kenako matani yonse. Mizere imakhala mindandanda pamodzi ndi malire a makhadi awo, makhadi amasunga ma tag, masiku, zofunika kwambiri, malo ndi mndandanda wowunika, ndipo Archive imakhala makhadi a mu Zosungidwa.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Matani JSON ya gulu la work-packages la OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Ma status amakhala mindandanda ndipo work packages zimakhala makhadi.
import-board-instruction-opml: Matani ndondomeko ya OPML, monga momwe Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq ndi mapulogalamu ena a ndondomeko amaitulutsira. Zinthu za pamwamba zimakhala mindandanda, ana awo amakhala makhadi ndi cholemba ngati kufotokoza, ndipo zinthu zakuya zimakhala mindandanda yowunika. Zinthu zomalizidwa zimalowetsedwa ngati zatha.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Matani fayilo ya Org mode, monga momwe Emacs, Orgzly kapena Beorg amailembera. Mitu ya pamwamba imakhala mindandanda ndipo mitu ya gawo lachiwiri imakhala makhadi. TODO ndi DONE, zofunika kwambiri, ma tag, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ndi CLOSED zimasungidwa, ndipo mabokosi owunika ndi mitu yakuya zimakhala mindandanda yowunika.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Mu Pivotal Tracker, tsegulani tabu ya MORE ya pulojekiti ndipo sankhani Export CSV (kapena sankhani nkhani ndikusankha Bulk Actions, CSV), kenako matani CSV. Mkhalidwe uliwonse wa nkhani umakhala mndandanda ndipo nkhani zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi mtundu ndi zilembo zawo, eni ake, wopempha, masiku, ndemanga, ntchito ndi zotchinga; Estimate imakhala Story points ndipo ma iteration amakhala ma sprint.
import-board-instruction-plane: Mu Plane, tsegulani Workspace Settings, sankhani Exports, tulutsani mapulojekiti ngati JSON, CSV kapena Excel ndipo tsitsani fayilo ya .zip, kenako sankhani fayiloyo, kapena fayilo imodzi yomwe ili mkati mwake, kapena matani JSON kapena CSV. Mikhalidwe imakhala mindandanda, mapulojekiti amakhala mizere yosambira, ndipo nkhani zimakhala makhadi pamodzi ndi chizindikiritso, kholo, owaperekera ntchito, zilembo, masiku, maulalo ndi ndemanga; zofunika kwambiri, kuyerekeza, cycle ndi module zimakhala malo apadera. Kutulutsa kwa Plane kulibe kufotokoza kapena zolumikizidwa, choncho sizilowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: Mu Quire, tsegulani menyu ya pulojekiti ndipo sankhani Export CSV, kenako matani CSV. Mikhalidwe imakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi tintchito ngati makhadi ana, owaperekera ntchito, ma tag ngati zilembo, masiku oyambira, omaliza ndi omalizidwa, kufotokoza ndi zofunika kwambiri ngati malo apadera. Ndemanga ndi zolumikizidwa sizili mu CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Mu Redmine, tsegulani Issues za pulojekiti, sankhani Also available in: CSV pansi pa mndandanda, sankhani mizati (All columns, ndi Description) ndipo tulutsani, kenako matani CSV. Redmine imatchula mizati m'chilankhulo chanu, choncho ikani chilankhulo chanu kukhala Chingerezi mu My account musanatulutse. Mkhalidwe uliwonse umakhala mndandanda ndipo nkhani zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi tracker ngati chizindikiro, woperekedwa ntchito, wolemba, masiku, ntchito ya kholo ndi nkhani zogwirizana; zofunika kwambiri, gulu, mtundu womwe ukuyembekezeka, nthawi yoyerekezedwa, % Done ndi malo apadera zimakhala malo apadera.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Mu Super Productivity, tsegulani Settings, kenako Sync & Backup, sankhani Export Data ndipo matani zomwe zili mu fayilo ya sp-backup .json. Pulojekiti iliyonse imakhala mzere wosambira ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi mu To Do, In Progress, Backlog kapena Done, pamodzi ndi zolemba, ma tag, tsiku lomaliza, nthawi yogwiritsidwa ntchito ndi tintchito; ntchito za mu Zosungidwa zimakhala makhadi a mu Zosungidwa.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Mu Taiga, tsegulani Admin > Project > Export ndipo tsitsani dump ya pulojekiti (tsegulani kaye fayilo ya .json.gz), kenako matani JSON yake. Mikhalidwe ya user story imakhala mindandanda, ma user story amakhala makhadi ndi ntchito zawo ngati tintchito, ma epic ndi nkhani zimapeza mizere yosambira yawoyawo, ndipo ma sprint, ma tag, ndemanga ndi makhalidwe apadera zimabweranso. Zolumikizidwa sizilowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Mu Tasks.org, tsegulani Settings, Backups ndipo sankhani Export tasks, kenako matani zomwe zili mu fayilo ya .json imeneyo. Mindandanda imakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi zolemba, ma tag, masiku, ndemanga ndi tintchito; ntchito zomalizidwa zimasunga tsiku lomwe zinamalizidwa, ndipo zofunika kwambiri zimakhala malo apadera.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Matani zotsatira za task export: mndandanda wa JSON kapena ntchito imodzi pamzere uliwonse. Ntchito zomalizidwa zimapita ku Done, project ndi priority zimakhala zilembo, annotations imakhala ndemanga, ndipo depends imakhala kudalira ntchito zomwe zimatsekereza.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Mu Teamwork.com, lembani template ya Excel yolowetsera ntchito (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ndipo isungeni ngati .xlsx, kenako sankhani fayiloyo. Mindandanda ya ntchito imakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi; ntchito yoyamba ndi -, # kapena > imakhala kantchito ka ntchito ya pamwamba pake (--, ## kapena >> gawo limodzi lakuya). Owaperekera ntchito, masiku ndi ma tag zimasunga malo awo; Priority, Estimated time ndi Complete zimakhala malo apadera.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Mu TickTick, tsegulani Settings, Account, Backup & Import ndipo pangani backup, kenako matani fayilo ya CSV. Mndandanda uliwonse wa TickTick umakhala mzere wosambira ndipo mizati yake imakhala mindandanda; ntchito zimasunga ma tag, masiku, mndandanda wowunika, zofunika kwambiri ndi tintchito.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Matani fayilo ya todo.txt: ntchito imodzi pamzere uliwonse, monga pulogalamu ya todo.txt ndi mapulogalamu ogwirizana nayo zimalembera. Ntchito zomalizidwa ("x") zimapita ku Zomalizidwa, +project ndi @context zimakhala zilembo, (A) imakhala chizindikiro cha kufunika, ndipo due: ndi t: zimakhala masiku omalizira ndi oyambira.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Mu Vikunja, tsegulani Settings, sankhani Data Export ndipo tsitsani fayilo ya .zip yomwe ikutumizirani, kenako sankhani fayiloyo, kapena matani data.json yomwe ili mkati mwake. Ma bucket a Kanban amakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi zilembo, owaperekera ntchito, masiku, kufotokoza, mindandanda ya ntchito ngati mindandanda yowunika ndi ndemanga; zofunika kwambiri, peresenti yomalizidwa ndi chomalizidwa zimakhala malo apadera. Zolumikizidwa sizilowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Mu Wrike, tulutsani pulojekiti kapena foda ku Excel, kapena lembani template ya Wrike yolowetsera Excel, kenako sankhani fayilo ya .xlsx imeneyo. Mizere ya foda ndi pulojekiti imakhala mizere yosambira, Status imakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi Key, ntchito ya kholo, owaperekera ntchito, masiku oyambira ndi omaliza, kudalirana ndi kufotokoza; Priority, Duration ndi mizati ina imakhala malo apadera.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Matani JSON yotumizidwa ya mndandanda wa ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages zimakhala mindandanda ndipo items zimakhala makhadi.

password-change-required-text: Tsambali tsopano limafuna mawu achinsinsi okhala ndi zilembo zosachepera __min__, ndipo anu ndi achidule. Sankhani atali kuti mupitirize. Kenako magawo onse a akaunti yanu amatulutsidwa, ndipo mumalowanso ndi mawu achinsinsi atsopano.
password-length-filter-fixed: Zakonzedwa kukhala mawu achinsinsi atali mokwanira
password-length-from-environment: Mtengo womwe wakhazikitsidwa mu malo a seva ukugwira ntchito; kusunga pano kumausintha.
password-length-report-desc: Maakaunti omwe adalowa ndi mawu achinsinsi achidule kuposa kutalika kochepa. Msakatuli yekha ndiye amadziwa kutalika kwa mawu achinsinsi, choncho amadziwitsa achidule atalowa; mawu achinsinsi ndi kutalika kwake sizimachoka mmenemo. Zakonzedwa ndi nthawi yomwe mawu achinsinsi a akaunti adasinthidwa - akaunti yomwe ikulowanso ndi mawu achinsinsi achidule imawonetsedwanso ngati yachidule kwambiri.
password-min-length-description: Kulowa ndi mawu achinsinsi achidule kwalembedwa pansipa. Kulowa sikukanidwa konse chifukwa cha izi.
password-min-length-enforce-description: Mawu achinsinsi atsopano achidule amakanidwa, ndipo akaunti yomwe ikulowa ndi mawu achinsinsi achidule iyenera kuwasintha isanachite china chilichonse. Kuwasintha kumatulutsa magawo onse a akaunti. Mawu achinsinsi a LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS ndi Sandstorm ndi a opereka awo, ndipo sawunikidwa.
password-pwned: Mawu achinsinsi awa adapezeka pa kutayikira kwa deta. Sankhani ena.
password-same-as-username: Mawu achinsinsi asakhale dzina logwiritsa ntchito kapena adilesi ya imelo.
password-too-short: Mawu achinsinsi ayenera kukhala ndi zilembo zosachepera __min__.
preview-pdf-not-supported: Chipangizo chanu sichithandiza kuona PDF patsogolo. Yesani kutsitsa m'malo mwake.
private-desc: Bolodi ili ndi lachinsinsi. Anthu okhawo omwe awonjezedwa pa bolodi ndi amene angalione ndi kulisintha.
public-desc: Bolodi ili ndi la anthu onse. Aliyense amene ali ndi ulalo angalione ndipo lidzaoneka m'makina osakira monga Google. Anthu okhawo omwe awonjezedwa pa bolodi ndi amene angalisinthe.

r-blocks-conflict: Lamulo ili lasintha pamene mumasintha. Tsitsaninso lamulo losungidwa musanasunge.
r-blocks-help: Lumikizani choyambitsa chimodzi ku chochita chimodzi. Kokani zipika kuchokera ku bokosi la zida. Gwiritsani ntchito chosinthira fomu pa zosankha zapamwamba.
r-blocks-invalid: Lumikizani choyambitsa chimodzi ndendende ku chochita chimodzi. Chotsani zipika zosalumikizidwa kapena zowonjezera musanasunge.
r-blocks-permission: Chilolezo cha woyang'anira bolodi chikufunika kuti musinthe malamulo.
r-blocks-unavailable: Deta ya lamulo palibe. Gwiritsani ntchito chosinthira fomu kuti muwunikenso lamulo ili.
r-cron-invalid: Ndandanda ya cron ili ndi magawo asanu: mphindi ola tsiku mwezi tsiku la sabata.

r-import-workflow-note: Lowetsani kayendedwe ka ntchito kooneka kotumizidwa kuchokera ku n8n kapena Node-RED. Ma node a zoyambitsa ndi zochita omwe amadziwika amafananitsidwa ndi malamulo a WeKan; ma node osafananitsidwa amanenedwa.

r-import-wrike-workflow-done: Kayendedwe ka ntchito ka Wrike "__name__": mindandanda __lists__ ndi malamulo __rules__ awonjezedwa, zigawo __skipped__ sizinawerengedwe

r-vars-people-hint: Komanso: {creator}, {assignees}, {members} (mayina a ogwiritsa ntchito m’mawu, maadiresi a imelo m’gawo la Wolandira) ndi {customField:Field name}. Izi zimagwiranso ntchito m’mayina a mamembala, mindandanda ndi njira za zochita zina.

r-when-a-card-title-or-description-conta: Pamene mutu kapena kufotokoza kwa kadi kuli ndi
r-workflow-help: Kokerani choyambitsa ndi chochita mu chomangira, kenako onjezani lamulo. Kokerani chochita pa lamulo lomwe lilipo kuti musinthe zomwe limachita.
r-wrike-workflow-note: Kayendedwe ka ntchito ka Wrike ndi mndandanda wa mikhalidwe, uliwonse mu gulu la Active, Completed, Deferred kapena Cancelled. Kutulutsa kumalemba mindandanda ya bolodi ili ngati kamodzi, kotchedwa dzina la bolodi, mu JSON yomwe API ya Wrike imabweza pa kayendedwe ka ntchito: pangani kayendedwe kameneko mu Wrike musanalowetse kutulutsa kwa Wrike Excel kwa bolodi, kuti mikhalidwe yake igwiritsidwe ntchito. Kulowetsa kumawerenga JSON imeneyo yomatidwa pamwambapa, kuchokera ku WeKan kapena ku GET /workflows ya Wrike, mu bolodi losankhidwa: mkhalidwe wopanda mndandanda umakhala mndandanda, ndipo lamulo limasonyeza kuti khadi latha likasamutsidwira ku mkhalidwe wa Completed kapena Cancelled ndipo silinathe likakhala mu Active kapena Deferred. Malamulo a automation a Wrike sangathe kutulutsidwa mu Wrike.

recovery-report-desc: Zochita zokha zoteteza ndi kukonza data: kuzindikira kuwonongeka, zosunga zobwezeretsera za data ya mawu, kubwezeretsa, kusamutsanso kuchokera ku MongoDB, ndi kukonza kokha nkhokwe ya data yomwe yakula mopitirira.
remove-cover: Chotsani chithunzi chakutsogolo pa khadi laling'ono
restore-all-skipped-wip-limit: Makhadi __count__ sanabwezeredwe: mindandanda yawo yafika malire awo a WIP. Abwezereni limodzi limodzi kuti musankhe mndandanda wina.
restore-card-no-list-with-room: Mndandanda uliwonse pa bolodi ili wafika malire ake a WIP. Kwezani malire, kapena sunthani kapena sungani makhadi, kuti mubwezere khadi ili.
restore-card-wip-limit-reached: Mndandanda __list__ wafika malire ake a WIP. Bwezerani khadi ku mndandanda wina:
scrum-backlog-help: Sanjani ntchito motsatira udindo mu ntchito zodikira. Patsani makhadi ku sprint yokonzedwa kapena yomwe ikuchitika.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Letsani sprint iyi? Makhadi ake adzakhalabe mmenemo mpaka atapatsidwanso kwina.
scrum-confirm-close: Tsekani sprint iyi ndi kusunga zotsatira zake? Makhadi osamalizidwa adzasamukira kumene mwasankha.
scrum-daily-empty: Palibe zowonedwa za tsiku ndi tsiku zomwe zalembedwa pa sprint iyi.
scrum-daily-observations: Kuchuluka kwa ntchito kwa tsiku ndi tsiku ndi ntchito yotsala (zowonedwa)
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Chowonedwa choyamba cholembedwa cha tsiku lililonse la UTC; masiku osowa sanaikidwe. Zowonedwa sizilemba kusintha kulikonse kapena ziŵerengero za kumapeto kwa tsiku. Kuyerekeza kosadziwika si ziro.
scrum-daily-observations-help: Mzere uliwonse umaonetsa chowonedwa choyamba cholembedwa cha tsiku la UTC, pa nthawi yoonetsedwa. Masiku osowa sanaikidwe. Zowonedwa zimenezi sizilemba kusintha kulikonse kapena kuonetsa ziŵerengero za kumapeto kwa tsiku. Kuyerekeza kosadziwika si ziro. Gwiritsani ntchito chochita cha Tulutsani cha gawo ili pa zowonedwa za tsiku ndi tsiku; chochita cha Tulutsani pa bala ya zida chimatulutsa zotsatira za sprint.
scrum-daily-truncated: Zowonedwa 366 zaposachedwa kwambiri zokha ndi zomwe zikuonetsedwa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Woyang'anira bolodi angathe kulibwezera mmbuyo kapena kusunga bolodi monga lilili.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Zosintha __applied__ mwa __total__ zinalembedwa, __pending__ sizinalembedwe, ndipo __conflicted__ zinasinthidwa ndi wina kuyambira pamenepo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Sungani cholembedwa chilichonse monga chilili tsopano, kuphatikizapo zosintha zomwe ntchito yoyimitsidwa yalemba kale?
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Kubwezera mmbuyo kumabwezeretsa cholembedwa chilichonse chosinthidwa monga chinalili kale; kumaperekedwa pokhapokha palibe wina amene wasintha zolembedwazo kuyambira pamenepo. Kusunga bolodi monga lilili kumachotsa ntchito yoyimitsidwa ndipo sikusintha zolembedwa. Mulimonse momwe zingakhalire, zimalembedwa mu Gulu la oyang'anira, Mavuto, Kubwezeretsa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Kubweza, kubwerezanso kapena kubwezeretsa zosintha za Scrum kunayima pa kusemphana. Kusintha kwa Scrum pa bolodi ili kwatsekerezedwa mpaka kutathetsedwa.
scrum-history-job-failed: Kubwezeretsa kusintha kwakukulu kapena kuchitanso kwayima. Dinaninso bwererani kapena chitaninso kuti mupitirize:
scrum-history-job-running: Kubwezeretsa kusintha kwakukulu kapena kuchitanso: __done__ mwa mizere ya mbiri __total__
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Khadi likufanana ndi makhadi oposa limodzi pa bolodi ili: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Khadi ndi la bolodi lina ndipo lasiyidwa osasinthidwa: __reference__
scrum-import-into-board: Lowetsani kukonzekera kwa Scrum mu bolodi ili
scrum-import-into-board-done: Kukonzekera kwa Scrum kwalowetsedwa ndi kulembedwa mu Mbiri.
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Sankhani fayilo yotulutsidwa ya bolodi la WeKan kapena fayilo yosamutsira Scrum. Ma sprint ndi zotulutsidwa zomwe bolodi ili lili nazo kale zimalumikizidwa, osabwerezedwa. Makhadi amafananitsidwa ndi ID, kapena ndi nambala ya khadi ndi mutu; makhadi osafanana amalembedwa ndi kusiyidwa osasinthidwa. Onani kaye kuti mudziwe zomwe zisinthe.
scrum-import-pending: Kulowetsa kwa Scrum sikunathe. Kusintha kwa Scrum ndi kutulutsa malipoti sikulipo.
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Palibe choti musinthe: bolodi ili lili kale ndi kukonzekera uku.
scrum-import-preview-releases: Zotulutsidwa: __created__ zatsopano, __matched__ zili kale pa bolodi ili, __skipped__ sizinalowetsedwe
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Ma Sprint: __created__ atsopano, __matched__ ali kale pa bolodi ili, __skipped__ sanalowetsedwe
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: Sprint kapena chotulutsidwa chikufanana ndi zoposa chimodzi pa bolodi ili: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: Sprint, chotulutsidwa kapena chochitika sichinathe kulowetsedwa: __reference__
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Kulowetsa komwe kwasokonezedwa ndi kuyambitsanso kungamalizidwe pano kukayima. Ngati ndondomeko yake sinasungidwe yonse, kungoletsedwa kokha ndi komwe kungachitike; izi sizisintha chilichonse pa bolodi.
scrum-import-sprint-finished: Khadi silinasunthidwe kupita mu sprint yomwe yatha: __reference__
scrum-no-closed-sprints: Palibe chithunzithunzi cha sprint yotsekedwa chomwe chilipo.
scrum-partial-report: Lipoti losakwanira: makhadi omwe mwapatsidwa panopa okha ndi omwe aphatikizidwa.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Sprint iyi ili ndi gawo lokha la chithunzithunzi choyambirira.
scrum-policy-doneLists: Khadi mu mndandanda wa gulu la Zatha
scrum-releases-select-help: Khadi likhoza kukhala mu zotulutsidwa zingapo. Gwirani Ctrl (Cmd pa Mac) kuti musankhe zoposa chimodzi; zichotseni zonse kuti muchotse khadi pa chotulutsidwa chilichonse.
scrum-report-help: Malipoti amasunga kuyerekeza kuchokera ku zithunzithunzi za sprint. Kuyerekeza kosadziwika kumawerengedwa padera; si kuyerekeza kwa ziro. Yerekezerani liwiro pakati pa miyeso ya kuyerekeza ndi malamulo ofanana okha.
scrum-rollover-progress: Kusunthira makadi a sprint patsogolo: __done__ mwa __total__
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: Khadi lasungidwa mu nkhokwe kapena labwezeretsedwa
scrum-scope-history: Kuchuluka kwa ntchito ndi ntchito yotsala, kusintha kulikonse
scrum-scope-history-empty: Palibe zosintha kuyambira pamene sprint inayamba.
scrum-scope-history-help: Zamangidwanso kuchokera mu mbiri ya bolodi kuyambira pamene sprint inayamba: mzere umodzi pa kusintha kulikonse kwa makhadi a sprint, zoyerekeza kapena ntchito yomalizidwa.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Mbiri siyikupanganso chithunzi cha mmene sprint iyi inalili: zosintha zina zinachitika popanda kulembedwa mu mbiri, choncho ziwerengerozi sizokwanira.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Zosintha zoyambirira zokha ndi zimene zinatha kuwerengedwa; kumanganso sikokwanira.
scrum-select-sprint: Sankhani sprint kuti muone lipoti lake.
